lines: Good! This strategy is pretty useful♪
It's quite fun once you get used to it!!
We used the "octopus ink smokescreen and electric wave detection + hammer smashing" tactic again and broke through the rebels' blockade, hurrying to the headmistress's office right ahead.
Now, now... no running in the hallway.
It was Muroi-sensei, the school physician, who had scolded us so leisurely. He was indispensable in a school with as many injuries as ours. But right nowー
This is not the time to be so nonchalant!! Justice hangs in the balance!!
There's a rebellion going on, it's an emergency!!
Th-Then you have to get out of here, Muroi-sensei!! It's not safe inside the school!!
But he just laughed heartily, his body swaying.
I may not look it, but I used to be a doctor in the Ground Self-Defense Forces. I've experienced quite a few battlefields like this.
That's why I'm able to move about calmly. While I keep an eye on the situation.
So that's it. He was deftly avoiding combat.
If that's the case, have you seen him, I mean Gaiza, anywhere?
I did. He pushed me out of the way and went into the headmistress's office.
Gaiza, you bastard... Muroi-sensei, go to the science lab for now! They don't have many troops and probably won't go to places that seem irrelevant.
After escorting Muroi-sensei to the science lab, we ran up the stairs to the headmistress's office.
